exposure: Stage of labor during primary cesarean delivery
Duration of labor in subsequent vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC)
cohort: Multiparous women undergoing their second delivery, including those who had a previous cesarean delivery and those who had vaginal deliveries
finding: Women who had a previous cesarean delivery during the second stage of labor had a shorter duration of labor in their subsequent VBAC compared to those who had a cesarean in earlier stages of labor.
